source.notes: Scanned school paper with no usable text layer; questions were OCR'd and corrected against page images. Printed session '2017-2018'; examYear taken as the later year. Time printed as '2 Hrs. + 15 min.' (15 minutes reading time; durationMinutes = 120 writing time). F. M. printed as 50; the heading 'SECTION A (80 Marks)' is printed but the question marks add up to 50. Some marks are printed without brackets (e.g. '2', '4').
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
